to: [`bare-sqlite-vector`](https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-sqlite-vector) — SQLite Vector bindings for Bare. It is a native addon that statically embeds the [`sqlite-vector`](https://github.com/sqliteai/sqlite-vector) extension and registers it against an existing `bare-sqlite` connection, adding vector encoding, nearest-neighbour search, and quantization-based ANN search to ordinary SQLite tables.
